status: additive development host ABI; no full Swift or production OTA qualification
legacy_contracts: Guest profile acceptance, existing C symbols, ABI version and all struct layouts remain unchanged
ownership: Inputs borrowed only for the call. Successful create owns decoded module/instance state. Never exposes guest memory or native pointers.

handles.representation: uint64_t; high32 generation, low32 slot+1; both nonzero
handles.scope: opaque native process-local identity, not a secret authorization token
ceiling_includes: closed instances retained by in-flight operations
handles.creation: reserve before decode/instantiation; no handle published until both succeed; failures/unwind release reservation
handles.reuse: increment generation before slot reuse; retire forever at UINT32_MAX; stale/zero/unknown/closed handles reject

state.success: memory and globals persist; invocation fuel and host-call counters reset to original narrowed limits
state.terminal: every interpreter error, including unknown export or signature mismatch, permanently terminates session; cancellation is permanent
state.api_rejection: invalid buffers, transfer bounds, malformed value encoding and busy rejection do not terminate session
state.panic: contained at C boundary; mutex poison prevents state reuse; close remains possible
state.limits: unchanged profile ceilings; caller can narrow with the existing MixerVmLimits structure

concurrency.operations: invoke/read/write hold one session mutex using try_lock; overlap returns status3 session_busy
concurrency.cancel: does not acquire the instance mutex; terminal flag plus cooperative cancellation; repeat cancel on live handle succeeds
concurrency.close: invalidates handle under registry lock, cancels, returns without waiting; in-flight calls retain storage and count against ceiling
concurrency.race_semantics: already admitted work can complete or mutate before observing cancellation; no rollback; a successful result may precede a concurrent cancel
concurrency.execution: cancellation at existing instruction/import/bulk boundaries; fuel is not a wall-clock deadline
concurrency.registry: bounded short mutex critical sections; decoding, execution, memory copies and large instance destruction happen outside registry lock

memory_transfer.offset: unsigned32 byte offset into current memory
memory_transfer.bounds: complete range checked before copying; zero length still requires offset <= memory length; no partial mutation on bounds failure
memory_transfer.cost: bounded native copy; no guest execution or guest fuel consumed
memory_transfer.caller_buffers: valid throughout call, no overlap with any other input/output; null permitted only with zero length

status_codes.3: invalid arguments, limits, transfer bounds, handle, busy or capacity

outputs: report required; null report returns3 with no mutation. Create sets non-null out_handle to0 before validation, except when report is null. Callers release successful handles explicitly.
